items.description: GET /api/skus/{sku} for a SKU with stock at two or more locations responds with Content-Type application/json, never text/html (NFR5-spa-json-boundary)

Playwright e2e (client/tests/e2e/sku-detail-locations.spec.ts) files a randomUUID-suffixed SKU at two locations plus another SKU's row via the live API, navigates the deployed /sku/:sku route, and asserts sku-detail and sku-locations show one sku-location-<loc> entry with sku-qty-<loc> per location and none from the other SKU

Playwright e2e (client/tests/e2e/sku-detail-tracking.spec.ts) opens the deployed /sku/:sku route for a randomUUID-suffixed SKU with a tracked location and asserts sku-tracking-<loc> shows the filed combined tracking code

Playwright e2e (client/tests/e2e/sku-detail-tracking.spec.ts) opens the deployed /sku/:sku route for a randomUUID-suffixed SKU with an untracked location and asserts that entry shows the sku-not-tracked badge instead of a blank

Playwright e2e (client/tests/e2e/sku-detail-par-level.spec.ts) opens the deployed /sku/:sku route for a randomUUID-suffixed stocked SKU and asserts sku-par-level contains sku-par-not-tracked with text Not tracked and no sku-error is shown
GET /api/skus/{sku} for a SKU with no stocked row responds 200 with Content-Type application/json, never an HTML error page (NFR5-spa-json-boundary)

Playwright e2e (client/tests/e2e/sku-detail-empty.spec.ts) opens the deployed /sku/:sku route for a never-filed randomUUID-suffixed SKU and asserts sku-empty states no stock at any location with a Receive link to /receive?sku=<sku>, no sku-location entries and no sku-error
